title: NO RIGHTS RESERVED

developer.name: RK-G Media Works
developer.role: TAPE DECK 02 player, tape building, chiptune arrangements (side A)

developer.name: Kimiko Ishizaka
developer.role: Piano, The Open Goldberg Variations (side B)

description:
A music album packaged as a cassette tape. It plays in TAPE DECK 02, a cassette-deck player program by RK-G Media Works, and was built with their TAPE FACTORY tool, which turns your own audio files into tape ROMs like this one.

All the music is public domain or CC0. Side A has chiptune arrangements of public-domain scores from the Mutopia Project: Bach's Prelude in C (BWV 846) and Invention 13 (BWV 784), Joplin's The Entertainer and Pineapple Rag, and Debussy's Arabesque No. 1 and Clair de lune. Side B has piano recordings from The Open Goldberg Variations by Kimiko Ishizaka (2012, CC0): the Aria, Variations 1, 7 and 30 (Quodlibet), and the Aria da Capo. The TAPE DECK 02 player itself is closed source.

Controls: A plays or pauses, B stops, Left and Right skip tracks, Up and Down change the volume, holding L or R rewinds or fast-forwards, Select changes the play mode and holding Select flips the tape to the other side.
